hypothesis: Tiny initial risk in fresh trigger entries distorts R-based summaries.
rule_delta: Compare one preregistered alternative: minimum risk of 0.1 daily ATR OR an explicitly defined 34 EMA stop, using a new strategy version. Choose before evaluation.
rationale: No floor or stop change is active; evaluate ATR units as well as R.

rule_delta: Keep saty-sig-2.0 unchanged; first conduct a 20-session observation audit, then register GG and stress-grid experiments on future data.
rationale: Twenty sessions are an initial operational review; promotion still requires the stricter registered evidence gates.

hypothesis: EOD-01 EOD context may improve a preregistered prospective comparison.
rule_delta: On 1m completed bars, compare the latest two strict 2-left/2-right price pivots with the EMA21/ATR14 smoothed phase proxy at each pivot. Higher high/lower phase is bearish; lower low/higher phase bullish. Pivot known only when the second right bar closes; most recent pivot within 12 bars.
rationale: Independent mechanical interpretation of the user-supplied cheat sheet. No probability and no baseline weight change.
guardrails: No use of backdated manual observations as past predictors
data_requirements: First receipt time separate from historical decision
episode_definition: Deduplicate by candidate, symbol, timeframe and confirming bar close; count correlated sessions separately.
overlap_policy: Session-cluster inference; no pooling timeframes as independent observations.
